cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The alley's blocked. Excellent: our secret proposal picnic just got harder to discover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm carrying your table. We have to use the main road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Better camouflage. Everyone will assume we're moving house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your girlfriend's coming down the road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Now she can carry the chairs without suspecting romance. The disguise gets more convincing.

mechanism: A corrects the helper's concealment tactics while celebrating blocked access and the intended recipient's arrival as better camouflage.
confusable: D137 says failure was intended; D140 celebrates the new sophistication created by an actual setback.
comparison: A helper carrying proposal furniture differs from an organizer managing a shrinking supper guest list.
seedUse: Use blocked alley and public route; the partner's practical help should become the next disguise, not just another obstacle.
